statement: From Tundra Outback onward there is much more randomness in surviving pet battles
One pet team limits RNG to the first wave or two, and cleared everything from Tundra Outback to Starfield Skies
The same pet composition is the basis for clearing Shores of Eternity
Time your first attack with the Defender so it blocks the first wave of axes
After blocking the first wave the Monolith should be up enough to survive the rest of the battles
Both Refillers must survive or there are not enough stacks to instantly spam the Monolith and avoid the next attack wave
Each time the Monolith pops spam several Bone Stack and have another Shield ready for almost 100% shield uptime
Shores of Eternity is harder than the other fights and probably needs the sixth pet
Watch where the Defender blocks so the whole first wave is blocked; afterwards spam all abilities as fast as possible with little RNG
Once the first pet dies survival gets much harder because damage has not stacked enough with the five-pet composition
Sixth pet is needed; a Ninja or another Rattler would make damage much more significant and probably clear it
Add a Ninja as the sixth pet for the Shores of Eternity six-pet composition
Ninja transforms basic attack into ninja stars which lets the Refiller be used more often and stacks Rattler stacks faster
Shores of Eternity is the only fight that currently needs six pets; five pets is possible but much harder
Clearing these territories helps get more Spices and increases all gains
